findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

A can was observed with major dents in the side and seams while it was intermixed with other cans on the shelf. The PIC was shown and moved the item to discard to correct. Ensure that the integrity of food packaging is maintained intact and safe at all times in the facility. Also ensure that any incoming foods are screened to ensure that the packaging and safety of the foods are maintained.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The deflector in the ice machine in the kitchen was observed with off white and pink pathogenic slime growth. Some was wiped off with a paper towel and the PIC shown. They were instructed to clean/sanitize the item and maintain it clean moving forward. They wiped it with a sani rag during the inspection to correct the immediate violation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

The fan over to the unit in the walk in cooler was observed with dust accumulation significant enough that pieces appeared read to fly off and potentially contaminate foods in the cooler. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11 Clean-up of Vomiting and Diarrheal Events. A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

When asked, the PIC was unable to provide effective Norovirus clean-up procedures in the facility. A fresh copy of the procedures distributed by SCDPH was given to correct. Ensure that all needed paperwork is available in the facility at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

The dish machine in the facility is not properly sanitizing dishes at the time of this inspection. The machine appears to be attempting to function but sanitizer is not dispensing from the tube into solution correctly. The PIC was consulted and contacted MJ Kelner for maintenance during this inspection. Both the three part sink and the dish machine are used for dishes in the facility. A follow-up is being set for Friday to ensure that the equipment is functioning correctly in complaince with the code.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

The bar three part sink was remade just prior to the inspector observation of that area of the facility. It is observed low once the tablet finished dissolving. The discussion with the PIC about procedures showed that they use one tablet in the sink. The sink holds two to three gallons of water and the bottle for the tablets indicate one to two tablets required per gallon of water. The bottle’s instructions as well as the use of test strips was discussed and the more tablets were added to bring the solution up to effective concentrations to correct. Ensure that all sanitizers int he facility are prepared and maintained at effective concentrations at all times moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The corner to the left of the walk in cooler is observed with the wall pulling away from the corner and exposing a gap. The PIC is instructed to have the location repaired prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that the physical facilities are maintained in good repair at all times.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.110 Using Dressing Rooms and Lockers. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions. 

1) An employee phone is observed on the prep counter near foods being prepared. 2) A cold neck band is observed on the top wire shelf of the standing freezer over open containers of food. The PIC was shown and instructed to store employee items so that contamination of food items is removed. The neck band was move into a bucket and onto the bottom shelf while the phone was removed to correct.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
The PERSON IN CHARGE shall: (K) proper sanitizing.

The dish machine noted on line item #16 needs maintenance conducted. This is to provide a follow-up date that is reasonable with a temporary sanitizing measure in effect. Follow-up in ten days.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

On arrival the dish machine is not producing effective levels of sanitizer in the rinse/sanitize solution. As the system is running it does not appear that any concentrate is being added via the relevant tubing. Per the PIC the three part sink is used as well as the dish machine at this time. The jug of concentrate is also a different color than normally observed and has likely off-gassed. This will need to be replaced. As a temporary measure the dish machine should not be utilized until maintenance/repair can be completed, especially after the sanitize step of the three part sink. Refer to line item #1 for follow up on the machine repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The blade of the can opener in the kitchen is observed soiled during this inspection. The PIC was unable to state when it was last used. It has been moved to dish for cleaning to correct. Ensure that food contact items are washed regularly to maintain clean.
